proposal.hypothesis: The selected explicit SSE2 parent computes four powers and a sum-of-products for each CND polynomial evaluation. Rewriting that same supplied polynomial in Horner form may reduce SIMD multiply instructions while leaving scalar logf/expf, the Black-Scholes formula, threading and the ordinary serial fallback unchanged. The altered rounding must pass varied-input tolerance checks; it may not improve performance, especially if scalar math remains dominant.

retained: Changed only the SSE2 CND polynomial evaluation to Horner form using the original coefficients.
Kept the ordinary scalar loop, scalar transcendental calls, explicit SIMD option kernel, SSE2 compile-time guard, fallback and tail handling unchanged.
